# What does this PR do ?

Enable NCCL EP and grouped tensors for the six 64-GPU Nemotron 3 Super B200/B300 BF16, MXFP8, and NVFP4 performance recipes, aligning their execution settings with the fastest recorded reference runs.

# Changelog

- Use the NCCL EP flex dispatcher and `moe_use_grouped_tensor=True`; remove HybridEP-specific environment settings.
- B200: TP2 / PP1 / CP1 / EP8 / ETP1 with sequence parallelism and pull/push enabled. BF16/MXFP8 use selective `moe_act`, `layernorm`, and `core_attn` recompute; NVFP4 uses `moe_act` and `layernorm`.
- B200: enable scoped TE graphs for Mamba, attention, MoE routing, and MoE preprocessing for all precisions.
- B300: retain TP1 / PP1 / CP1 / EP8 / ETP1 and scoped TE graphs. BF16/NVFP4 retain `moe_act` and `layernorm` recompute; MXFP8 retains disabled recompute. Add `NVTE_TENSOR_HANDLE_POOL_SIZE_MB=128` and `TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1`.
- Keep sequence length 8192, GBS512, and MBS1. Preserve model construction and MTP settings.
- Add/update focused regression tests. Lightning and Nano recipe functions are unchanged.

# Performance comparison


| GPU | Precision | Current perf  | NCCL-EP Perf | Reference job ID | Improvement |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| B300 | BF16 | 698.37 | 756.64 | 920737 | +8.34% |
| B300 | FP8-MX | 662.68 | 860.16 | 920724 | +29.80% |
| B300 | NVFP4 | 658.79 | 854.41 | 920722 | +29.69% |
| B200 | BF16 | 561.80 | 567.80 | 2400624 | +1.07% |
| B200 | FP8-MX | 472.42 | 580.94 | 2400808 | +22.97% |
| B200 | NVFP4 | 392.47 | 579.88 | 2317834 | +47.75% |

+"""NCCL EP dispatch contracts for B200 and B300 Nemotron 3 Super recipes."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import pytest
+
+from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.environment import HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES
+from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.nemotronh.b200 import nemotronh as b200
+from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.nemotronh.b300 import nemotronh as b300
+from megatron.bridge.training.config import ConfigContainer
+from tests.unit_tests.recipes.recipe_test_utils import patch_recipe_construction_dependencies
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _keep_recipe_construction_offline(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    patch_recipe_construction_dependencies(monkeypatch)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("module", (b200, b300), ids=("b200", "b300"))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("precision", ("bf16", "fp8mx", "nvfp4"))
+def test_nemotron_super_bseries_nccl_ep_stack(module, precision: str) -> None:
+    gpu = module.__name__.split(".")[-2]
+    factory: Callable[[], ConfigContainer] = getattr(
+        module, f"nemotron_3_super_pretrain_64gpu_{gpu}_{precision}_config"
+    )
+    cfg = factory()
+
+    assert cfg.model.moe_token_dispatcher_type == "flex"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == "ncclep"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor is True
+    expected_ep = 8
+    assert cfg.env_vars["NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH"] == 1
+    assert cfg.env_vars.keys().isdisjoint(HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES)
+    assert cfg.model.expert_model_parallel_size == expected_ep
+    assert cfg.model.tensor_model_parallel_size == (2 if gpu == "b200" else 1)
+    assert cfg.model.sequence_parallel is (gpu == "b200")
+    assert cfg.train.global_batch_size == 512
+    assert cfg.env_vars["CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS"] == 32
+    assert ("NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY" in cfg.env_vars) == (gpu == "b300")
+    if gpu == "b300":
+        assert cfg.env_vars["NVTE_TENSOR_HANDLE_POOL_SIZE_MB"] == 128
+        assert cfg.env_vars["TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS"] == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("module", (b200, b300), ids=("b200", "b300"))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("precision", ("bf16", "fp8mx", "nvfp4"))
+def test_nano_base_keeps_hybridep(module, precision: str) -> None:
+    gpu = module.__name__.split(".")[-2]
+    cfg = getattr(module, f"nemotron_3_nano_pretrain_8gpu_{gpu}_{precision}_config")()
+
+    assert cfg.model.moe_token_dispatcher_type == "flex"
